plans.note: Separate caps for each party at 9.1 (IBM) and 9.2 (Customer); check cap amount/formula, mutuality, consequential-damages exclusion and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP, fees due). 5.4 Other Disclaimers may add exclusions that effectively narrow IBM exposure.

8.1 is the IBM indemnity (test IP infringement scope, defense/settlement, and any narrowing to hosted components); 8.2 plus the numbered notice/cooperation conditions at sec-1 govern our reverse indemnity — confirm it stays narrow (our content/AUP breach only) and is subject to the 9.2 cap.

No non-compete heading; 14.16 Freedom of Action typically preserves each party's right to compete (helpful to us). Scan 14.11 No Resale for any restriction beyond resale that limits our business lines.

Hosting agreements of this type rarely bind the customer to exclusivity; verify 14.16 and the services/charges provisions contain no sole-source or 'all requirements' language before concluding absent.
No pricing-parity heading in the outline; check 4.1 Charges for any obligation running against us. An MFN in our favour, if found, is not to be flagged.

14.8 Personnel is the likely home for any hire/solicit restriction; check whether it binds us, its duration, whether it is mutual, and whether general advertising and unsolicited applicants are carved out.

3.4 is the convenience termination clause: check notice period, whether it is available to us, and any termination charge/unamortized-cost penalty in 3.4/3.5 or 4.1. Also confirm IBM cannot terminate for convenience mid-term.

3.2 Renewal: test auto-renewal length, non-renewal notice window and who must give it, and whether renewal pricing uplift is capped (uncapped uplift is a note, not necessarily a deviation). Read with 3.1 Term and Order Form terms.

14.3 Choice of Law is the operative clause (IBM standard is often New York); confirm no foreign arbitration and note venue. 14.4 jury waiver and 14.14 Actions Period (contractual limitations period) are related but assessed under this rule only for forum/venue effect.

14.10 Assignment: check whether we may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger/asset sale without consent, whether change of control is deemed an assignment giving IBM a termination right, and whether IBM's own assignment/subcontracting is unrestricted.

Ownership is likely split across 12.1 License and 14.17 Limitation of Licenses (retained rights); 11.6 Content and 14.18 Data Protection cover our data. Confirm no grant or assignment of our content/data/marks to IBM beyond a hosting licence, and check 14.6 for trademark use limits.

12.1 is the grant to us of Base Components: test scope (affiliates/contractors/end users), revocability, term-coextensiveness and any use restrictions; 14.17 likely narrows all licences and 12.2 covers maintenance of the licensed components.

11.3 Suspected Violations is the probable inspection/monitoring hook against us, read with 13.2 Acceptable Use Policy; check for notice, frequency, on-site access and who bears cost. If it is only a monitoring right and no true audit exists, treat as absent.

Look for late-payment interest or early-termination/penalty charges in 4.2 and 3.5 that function as liquidated damages against us; ordinary interest at a commercial rate is not a deviation. Service credits in our favour, if any, are welcome.

5.1 contains IBM's warranties and 5.2/5.4 the disclaimers — check for a workmanlike/conformity warranty, its duration, and a real remedy (re-performance or refund) rather than pure disclaimer. 11.1 Services Support and 12.2 Maintenance bear on the remedy; 11.2 is our warranty and should stay narrow.
No insurance heading; 14.12 Risk of Loss and 5.3 Security are the nearest analogues. If no coverage obligation exists anywhere, record as missing given IBM hosts our data.

Check 4.1 Charges (and any Order Form minimums referenced there) plus 11.5 Capacity Planning for committed volumes, minimum monthly fees or ratchets; if a commitment exists, confirm the 3.4 convenience exit relieves it.

3.5 Effect of Termination is the likely location for wind-down, data return/deletion and any transition services; if it only addresses payment and access cut-off, flag the absence of return of our content and migration assistance. 14.2 Survival confirms what continues.
